decisionsTitle: The internal notes are the registrations export's last column, for the roles that may keep them (amending §777, §172 and §779)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15, from his phone:** «cum stăm cu coloana de comentarii pentru participanți? asta trebuie de asemenea să fie și în Excel!» His standing word on the open points was «YOLO»: they are decided below, each with its reason, and the owner may turn any of them over.

**What this reverses.** §777 made the notes readable on the registration's page, in the list's marker and in «Toate datele unei persoane», and put them in no export; a source-guard test listed the only importers of the table. The owner now wants them in the Excel. They are in it, and in the CSV beside it; the other surfaces stay as §777 left them: the race-day desk (§67, a name, a state and a number), the public list and every email read no note.

**The column.** «Note interne» (Română) / «Internal notes» (English) — the card's own title — is the **last** column of both files: the spreadsheet has no column of the participant's own remarks to put it beside, and last keeps every earlier column where a script or a person's habit finds it. The language is the list's: the button now sends `lang` as the sponsor list's does, and a missing or unknown one is Română. The rest of the sheet's headers stay English as they were; only this one follows the reader, because the words inside it (the roles) must.

**The cell.** One note a line, newest first, each «<data> · <rolul autorului>: <text>». The date is the event's own clock (`dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm`, the zone of the event the registration is for); the author is a **role**, never a name, as on «Toate datele unei persoane» (§777: a colleague's name is the colleague's data) — the role the author has now, as that page reads it, not the one they had when they wrote the note (storing it on the note would need a migration); an author whose account is gone reads «cont șters» / «account removed». A note's own line breaks stay inside its lines. The cell is text, so a note beginning with `=` is never a formula, and the spreadsheet's cell wraps. It is cut at a note's end below 32 000 characters (Excel keeps 32 767 and drops the rest silently) and the last line says «… (mai multe note pe pagina înscrierii)» / «… (more notes on the registration's page)». The role words are in both catalogues under `Admin.registrations.notes.exportRole`, and a test holds the Română ones equal to the backoffice's own role labels, so there are not two lists to drift. A soft-deleted note has no words and is never read.

**Who gets it, asserted on the server (BR-REQ-060-01).** The export route asks `canKeepRegistrationNotes(actor.role)` before it asks for the column, and the reader asserts it again, as every other function of `notes.ts` does. Today the roles that export — the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator — are exactly the roles that keep notes, so the check never refuses; it is written (and tested for every role) so that moving either boundary moves the column, and a role that may export but not keep notes would get the file without it. The Tehnic role, the volunteer, the Redactor and a member get no file at all, as before. The trail row `registration.exported` records `withNotes` — whether the file carried the column — and never a word of a note.

**One query.** `listRegistrationNotesForExport` in `notes.ts` reads the live notes of all the exported registrations in one grouped select (`registration_id IN (…)`, `created_at` then `id` descending, the author's role from a left join), never one per row; `exportNotesCell` writes a cell from them. The two writers of the files (`csv.ts`, `workbook.ts`) are handed a string, not the table: they name no note table or reader.

**The guard test (`notes-never-leave.test.ts`).** The export route joins the readers' list — the one new reviewed edit — and the test also asserts that the route asks the role's predicate and calls the export reader exactly once. The desk, the public pages, the emails, the repository's own queries and the two writers stay refused, by name and by import.

**The privacy notice's template.** Section 2's sentence about internal notes now says they are seen only by the club's organizers and administrators, in the administration page and in the registrations export (Excel or CSV) they download, and that an exported file is deleted within section 7's times. The template only: the texts in force move only when the club approves a version made from it.

**Refused.** The author's name in the file (the rule of §777's person data); a second sheet, or a column per note (a filter is one column away from a surprise); a tick per download («cu note» / «fără note») — the role's rule is the rule, a button is not a permission; the notes in the desk's sheet or the sponsor list; leaving the CSV out (it is the same rows, and a script that reads the file reads the notes with them); a new dependency.

**The in-app guide.** The two «Lasă o notă pe o înscriere» sentences that said notes never appear in the export now say they are the last column, the download steps gain one about it (both languages).

**Tests that moved.** Two integration tests that read the CSV's columns from the end shifted by one for the role that now gets the new last column, and the five that call the export route now answer `getTranslations({ locale, namespace })` from the catalogues (`tests/helpers/intl-server.ts` or their own mock), since the route words the column in the reader's language.
changelogLine: - **«Note interne» in the registrations export** — the Excel and the CSV end with a column of the registration's internal notes for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator: one note a line, newest first, «<data> · <rolul>: <text>», the author as a role and never a name, in the language of the list. The privacy notice's template says where the organizers see them. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends BR-REQ-037-03 criterion 22: the CSV and the spreadsheet now carry the notes as their last column for the roles that keep them; the desk, the public list and every email still carry none. Given the registrations export, when the Organizer, the Administrator or the Superadministrator downloads the Excel or the CSV, then it ends with a column «Note interne» («Internal notes» with the list's language English) holding the registration's live notes in one grouped query — one note a line, newest first, «dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm · <the author's role>: <text>» with the date on the event's clock, the author a role and never a name («cont șters» when the account is gone), a soft-deleted note never, an empty cell for none, the cell cut at a note's end below 32 000 characters with «… (mai multe note pe pagina înscrierii)» — and a role that may export but not keep notes (`canKeepRegistrationNotes`, asserted in the route and again in the reader) gets the file without the column, while the Tehnic role, the volunteer, the Redactor and a member get no file; the desk, the public list and every email still read no note, and `notes-never-leave.test.ts` admits the export route as a reader and refuses every other file (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `registrations/notes-export.test.ts`, `registrations/notes-never-leave.test.ts`; integration `registrations/notes-in-export.test.ts`, `registrations/notes-in-export-no-keep.test.ts`; e2e `notes-in-export.spec.ts`.

Given the privacy notice's template in both languages, when it is read, then section 2's sentence on internal notes also says that only the club's organizers and administrators see them, in the administration page and in the registrations export (Excel or CSV) they download, and that an exported file is deleted within the times of section 7 — the template only, the texts in force unchanged until the club approves a version made from it (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/privacy-internal-notes.test.ts`.
